thread:
Mia K: Heads-up — observed EU agg-hours gaps for 2026-03-18 00:00-06:00 UTC. Looks like a late-ingest > TTL issue. Thinking we should extend TTL for that window and run a targeted recompute (disable dedupe for idempotency). Thoughts? :eyes:

Kevin L: Can you paste the detection query so I can sanity-check the buckets?

Mia K: Sure — quick grep we used:```sql
SELECT hour, count(*) FROM telemetry.agg_hours
WHERE region = 'eu' AND hour >= '2026-03-18T00:00:00Z' AND hour < '2026-03-18T06:00:00Z'
GROUP BY hour HAVING count(*) < expected_count;```

Jonas P: SGTM. My only ask: run the recompute as a low-priority job and throttle concurrency (avoid overloading ingest). Snapshot current aggregates before touching them so we can rollback.

Priya R: Extending TTL will increase the replay queue size. Suggest we do a short streaming catch-up for the first 2 hours (to absorb the majority) and then a small windowed backfill for the remainder. That should keep steady-state queue <100k.

infra-bot: scheduler: created job backfill-2005012345-eu in pool=low-priority, scheduled=2026-03-19T02:00:00Z, owner=@jonas P, eta=2h

Sophia G: I'll mute the agg-hours stale alert for EU for 4h and add a note on the dashboard about the planned recompute.

Kevin L: Reminder to bump recompute concurrency config for this run (we usually default to 32, drop to 8 for EU run). Edit /ops/recompute/config.yaml -> concurrency: 8. Also set backfill.rate_limit: 20rps.

Mia K: Plan: I'll run a dry-run now with --dry-run and post the logs. If dry-run looks good, we start full backfill at 02:00 UTC. Command I'm using:```bash
./infra backfill \
  --start 2026-03-18T00:00:00Z \
  --end 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z \
  --pool low-priority \
  --concurrency 8 \
  --rate-limit 20 \
  --disable-dedupe \
  --dry-run
```Logs will be at s3://redwood-telemetry/backfills/2005012345/dryrun.log

Jonas P: I'll watch the collector backlog and be standing by. Ping me if backlog >100k or if error rate spikes.

Priya R: If we hit unexpected duplicates after rehydrate, we can roll-forward with a corrected post-process, but agree to keep dedupe off for the initial pass to ensure completeness.

Mia K: Dry-run finished — small schema warning only (non-blocking). Pasting tail of log:```
[INFO] scan windows: 6
[WARN] missing schema field: device.platform (defaulting)
[INFO] simulated writes: 12,432 rows
[INFO] estimated runtime: 12m
```If no objections I'll flip to real run at 02:00 UTC and update the dashboard note. :thumbsup:
